userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Attention order uses |USD-move z| × |divergence z| × US-exposure weight; liquidity breaks ties. Divergence-only views sort by |divergence|. userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Snapshot timing
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Reference period identifies the data window. Source available is when the provider released it; acquired and qualified is when it passed collection checks; published is when the snapshot became available here. Clocks use UTC; exchange session dates are local. Publication does not make older source data current.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 参考期表示数据区间；来源可得时间表示供应商发布时刻；采集与校验时间表示数据通过采集检查的时刻；发布时间表示快照在本产品可用的时刻。时间戳使用 UTC，交易日期以当地交易所为准。快照发布不代表旧来源已更新。

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Why a reading is unavailable
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Missing, stale, restricted and unscored are different states. A missing index close removes its market from move ranking; late FX qualifies USD return while local return remains. Required unscored market readings block transmission. Qualified, stale or partial inputs limit stance to Watch. Quarterly BIS data supplies background and is never forward-filled.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 缺失、过期、受限和未评分是不同状态。指数收盘缺失时不参与变动排名；汇率延迟时美元回报须附条件，本地回报仍可显示。必要读数未评分时不展示传导路径。输入附条件、过期或不完整时，立场最多为观察。BIS 季度数据仅作背景，不向前填充。

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Scenarios and replay
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Scenarios are conditional model estimates. A band crossing zero is unscored. Replay shows stored snapshots and preserves what was available at the selected time; later corrections do not rewrite that view. A watch rechecks its conditions on each snapshot and sends notifications only.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 情景是条件模型估计；区间跨零时不评分。回放使用已保存快照，保留所选时刻可得的信息；后续修订不重写旧视图。监控在每次快照上复核条件，仅发送通知。

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Transmission response
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Each channel has its own evidence and US response window. Pending means the window or required value is not complete; absent means no response inside that window and does not refute the channel. Structural lending exposure is not tested as a same-day price response. Channel size is separate from evidence that a move travelled it.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 每条渠道都有独立证据和美国市场响应窗口。待定表示窗口或必要数值尚未完整；无响应表示窗口内未观察到响应，并不否定该渠道。结构性借贷敞口不按当日价格响应检验。渠道规模与本次变动是否沿该渠道传导须分别判断。

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Revenue geography
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Country share = reported country revenue ÷ consolidated revenue for the same fiscal period. Explicit zero, missing disclosure and regional-only disclosure remain distinct. A regional total is not allocated to Japan without a reported split. Customer destination does not establish invoice currency, profit share or earnings sensitivity.

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Common sector weights
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: This example uses a 50:50 blend of the two starting allocations, held fixed for one period. Each sector contributes common weight × (Japan return − Taiwan return). Contributions sum to 1.226 pp, displayed as 1.23 pp. The four defined groups cover 100% of reference weight; Other is not a fallback for unmapped sectors. This reweighting does not isolate a pure country effect.

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Scenario assumptions
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Hold the selected local price return fixed and change only the currency return over the same period. Combine them multiplicatively. Results are conditional calculations, not probabilities or price targets. Price-return examples exclude dividends, hedging, fees and taxes; they do not represent an ETF investor’s net return or company earnings.

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Return calculation
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: USD return = (1 + local return) × (1 + currency return) − 1. FX contribution is USD return minus local return, in percentage points; it includes compounding. Compare the same period and return basis. Local session dates may differ. Index price returns exclude an ETF’s fees and investor-specific costs.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 美元回报 =（1 + 本地回报）×（1 + 汇率回报）− 1。汇率贡献为美元回报减去本地回报，以百分点表示，包含复利交互项。比较相同区间和回报口径，并核对本地交易日期。指数价格回报不包含 ETF 费用或投资者个人成本。

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Historical dates
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Compare the same markets, dates, return basis and method. This view uses revised data to recompute the past. It does not show what was known at the time; original-known vintages are unavailable. Check each observation date and revision before interpreting a change.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 比较时保持市场范围、日期、回报口径和方法一致。本视图使用修订后的数据重算历史，不能说明当时已知什么；原始可得版本尚不可用。解读变化前请核对观察日期和修订记录。

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Sector sources
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: This example uses four synthetic sector baskets. The common weights are a 50:50 blend of the two starting allocations and cover 100% of this example. “Other” is a defined basket. No live constituent roster or provider source is supplied. Inspect the four-sector calculation for each contribution.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 本示例使用四个合成行业组合。共同权重是两组初始配置各占一半的混合，覆盖示例权重的 100%。“其他”是有明确定义的组合。此处未提供真实成分股名单或供应商来源。可查看四行业计算以核对各项贡献。

userVisibleSectionCopy.title: Tool coverage
userVisibleSectionCopy.text: Choose a tool to see which measures qualify for the selected market and period. Missing, stale and inaccessible values remain distinct. A search match does not establish data coverage. Each result keeps its own unit, observation date and source; unavailable measures do not become zero.
userVisibleSectionCopy.textZh: 选择工具后，可查看哪些指标符合当前市场与区间的要求。缺失、过期和无访问权限须分别显示。搜索命中不代表数据可用。每项结果保留单位、观察日期和来源；不可用的指标不计为零。
